events.evidence: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that North Korea has now become directly involved in the war in Ukraine
U.S. President Joe Biden announces a new $425 million military aid package for Ukraine, containing long-range weaponry
At least 16 people, including the mayor are killed in an IAF airstrike on a municipal building of Nabatieh, southern Lebanon

label.note: North Korea's reported troop involvement and long-range Ukraine aid raise escalation risk; Lebanon strike adds geopolitical strain.
